'''This woman''' was the mother of [[Tyrnia Masak]]. Living in the slums of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], she fell into debt with the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Durrsk]] who took her daughter as payment. She was later killed by Durrsk, leading to her daughter killing the crime lord as revenge.
